fields.Name: Jev
fields.Description: TypeSafe's typed-decision model. It answers Likelihood, Choice (up to 255 options) and Score (2 to 10 levels) questions about a state of up to 32,000 tokens with probabilities, in one call, typically in 70 to 500 ms. It writes no text. Its raw probabilities rank well but are not calibrated to MJ's data, so set thresholds on calibrated values. Reached through OpenRouter's Decisions API, pinned to a dated version.

Calibrations.Question: continues
Calibrations.FittedOn: Phase 2 Decision Eval, conversation-routing cell 'production', 2026-09-29: 301 scored points (174 switch, 127 continue), 5 repeats, private corpus (corpus.jsonl SHA-256 08dd187af4318a93…). Out of fold: balanced accuracy 0.800 raw → 0.928 calibrated, ECE 0.226 → 0.041. Fitted at the corpus mix (42% continue), then B shifted by logit(0.9) − logit(127/301) = +2.5121 to a chat's 90%-continue mix (B at the corpus mix: -3.3506).

Calibrations.Question: agent
Calibrations.FittedOn: Agent-discovery Decision Eval, 2026-09-29: 258 requests × 3 repeats; Choice confidence against whether it named the labelled agent (594 answers). At a calibrated 0.85: 21.7% coverage at 95.3% precision.

Calibrations.Question: anyApplies
Calibrations.FittedOn: Agent-discovery Decision Eval, 2026-09-29: 258 requests × 3 repeats; Likelihood against whether the request was meant for an agent (774 answers).

Calibrations.Question: note
Calibrations.FittedOn: Memory-note gate measurement, 2026-09-29: 60 synthetic conversations, 337 candidate notes, 2 repeats. At a calibrated 0.6: durable notes kept at 96.1% precision, 95.4% recall; 6.2% of ephemeral notes kept.

Calibrations.Question: duplicate
Calibrations.FittedOn: Duplicate-check measurement, 2026-09-29: 160 labelled new MJ: Actions records (80 rewrites, 80 similar), 5 vector candidates each.
